item.title: RETURN TO SILENT HILL Interview: Hannah Emily Anderson & Evie Templeton Tease Their Horror Roles (Exclusive)
item.description: Return to Silent Hill stars Hannah Emily Anderson and Evie Templeton discuss their roles in the upcoming video game adaptation, talking up the practical effects and co-star Jeremy Irvine.

item.title: 28 YEARS LATER: THE BONE TEMPLE Underperforms As AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH Remains #1 For Fifth Week In A Row
item.description: The Marvels director Nia Costa's 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple opened in theaters this weekend, but it's fallen short of industry projections and will be beaten by Avatar: Fire and Ash.

item.title: GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY Star Chris Pratt Names The Only Person He'd Reveal His AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Status To
item.description: Guardians of the Galaxy star Chris Pratt has once again been asked about his Avengers: Doomsday status, and names the one person he'd be willing to spill the beans to, if asked.

item.title: Finn Wolfhard Makes HARRY POTTER NSFW In SNL's HEATED RIVALRY Spoof
item.description: SNL spoofed HBO’s upcoming Harry Potter TV remake by imagining a version that borrows its tone and inspiration from another hit HBO series, Heated Rivalry.

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW Director James Gunn Reveals Whether Wonder Woman Will Appear; Update On Grant Gustin's Flash
item.description: Man of Tomorrow writer and director James Gunn has revealed whether there's any truth to persistent rumours about Batman and Wonder Woman appearing in the Superman sequel.

item.title: THE BRAVE AND THE BOLD: James Gunn Implies We'll Be Waiting A LONG Time For DCU Batman Casting News
item.description: DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn has shared an update on where things stand with the DCU's Dark Knight, confirming that he doesn't want The Brave and the Bold to clash with The Batman Part II.

item.title: Kathleen Kennedy's Exit Reveals A Secret Animated INDIANA JONES Series Was Quietly Cancelled
item.description: As coverage of Kathleen Kennedy’s exit from Lucasfilm continues to dominate the news cycle, fresh details have surfaced about a secret Indiana Jones animated project.

item.title: Marvel Comics Teases Major Character Death In AMAZING SPIDER-MAN/VENOM: DEATH SPIRAL Final Issues
item.description: Marvel Comics has shared a first look at April's Death Spiral issues, and it sounds like we should brace ourselves for a major character death as the event concludes.
